review_notes: I read the whole file statically. I did not open any other files, because nothing in the target needed a comparison. The file introduces no `def`, `structure`, `class`, `abbrev`, `instance` or `notation`. It contains only theorems, lemmas and aliases. The aliases are `Monotone.dual_left`, `StrictMono.dual` and similar. All of them extend the `Monotone`/`Antitone`/`StrictMono`/`StrictAnti` predicates from `Mathlib.Order.Monotone.Defs`, and none competes with them. The statements `isStable_toDual_comp_iff` and `Nat.rel_of_forall_rel_succ_*` use the existing `IsStable` and the existing `IsTrans`, `Std.Refl` classes. The statements about `Nat.stabilises_*`, `converges_of_monotone_of_bounded`, `List.foldl_monotone` and the `exists_strictMono` family are standalone results. Overlap between them and existing theorems would be theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. I therefore found no competing version of a concept.
